meta_description:
462 likes, 30 comments - mombae.blogger on October 29, 2026: "This is THE day I wait for all year! ❤️

A day when I get to dress up like a newlywed, go all out with my Solah Shringar, wear all the jewellery, adorn myself with mehendi and feel every bit of that just-married bride again. ✨

I absolutely love the rituals, the traditions and the feeling of fasting for the person you love. And this year, the day came with the sweetest surprise!

While I was fasting for him, he was fasting for me too, without telling me. I only found out much later, and honestly, nothing could have made the day more romantic. Sometimes, love is in the little things, the unspoken gestures and the thoughtfulness that takes you completely by surprise. ❤️

A day full of love, laughter, traditions, a little bit of dressing up (okay, A LOT!) and memories to cherish.

Already counting down to the next year 🥹❤️

Happy Karva Chauth! 🌙

#karwachouthspecial♥️ #karwachauthvibes❤️ #karwachauth #indiantraditions".
